text: The Patriots head to Chicago for Thursday Night Football against the Bears in a matchup that reunites Drake Maye with fellow draft classmate Caleb Williams, two quarterbacks who've known each other for years through football camps and their shared draft class—though Maye will have to do so without some key offensive weapons after a chaotic week on the injury front. Romeo Doubs, who hauled in a 42-yard touchdown pass early in Sunday's 26-19 win over the Jets, has been placed on injured reserve following that catch, while A.J. Brown, returning from a four-week absence due to a right high ankle sprain, struggled in his comeback with a career-high three dropped passes despite the team's victory. Maye himself was sharp in that Jets game, throwing three touchdown passes to help the Patriots improve to 2-0 in the AFC East, and the offensive gameplan heading into this short-week road trip will lean heavily on his play-action work and the staples of offensive coordinator Johnson's scheme—meaning the team's stars will need to step up considerably against a Bears defense on what figures to be a challenging Thursday night in Chicago.
